# MESH_NETWORK_SHARED

A mesh control plane as a cluster that does not run it can address it.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

Canonically `mesh`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.mesh`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

A **projection**: a narrowed view of another signature, for crossing a
boundary. Whatever provides the signature it narrows answers this, so it
has no provider of its own.
